summary: This PR adds a `break_on_hyphens` parameter to `wrap_text()` in `src/click/formatting.py` to prevent usage line arguments from being split at hyphens. The `HelpFormatter.write_usage()` method now passes `break_on_hyphens=False` when wrapping option names and metavar values, addressing issue #3362. Tests verify that hyphenated option names stay on one line while the default behavior for general text wrapping remains unchanged.
